SIDDHANT PRAKASH JOSHI

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
PSPO I Certified Product Owner and Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of Agile delivery across enterprise BFSI and digital SaaS 
platforms. Deep domain expertise across Capital Markets (Equities, ECM, Fixed Income, FX, Trade Finance), Wealth Management 
platforms, UPI/NPCI payment rails, AML/KYC, Regulatory Reporting, and Core Banking. Proven track record defining product 
roadmaps, owning prioritised backlogs, running sprint ceremonies, and shipping digital products on time and within scope. Hands-
on experience with NPCI integrations, merchant onboarding, and payment system compliance for leading PSU banks. Skilled cross-
functional collaborator with technology, UX, risk, compliance, and legal teams. Delivered INR 28L+ business impact across marquee 
banking clients including SBI, HDFC Bank, and Canara Bank. 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

• Acted as Product Owner for TasC+ and Compliance Kartavya+ (AML/KYC & Regulatory SaaS); owned backlog prioritisation 
based on business value, customer impact, compliance requirements, and delivery dependencies. 
• Defined product roadmap, release planning, sprint goals, and acceptance criteria; collaborated with UI/UX team on user flows, 
wireframes, and information architecture. 
• Elicited requirements from cross-functional stakeholders — Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, UX, Technology, and QA — to 
define critical user journeys, workflows, and data models. 
• Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives; conducted backlog grooming and ensured 
sprint readiness across delivery teams. 
• Managed UAT achieving 99% test coverage with near-zero production defects; defined KPIs, adoption metrics, and product 
performance dashboards. 
• Scaled product from MVP to MVP+2 in 5 months; delivered INR 28L+ business impact (Canara Bank INR 10L; HDFC Bank INR 
18L). 
Business Analyst / Agile Delivery Lead | Orient Technologies Ltd Nov 2018 – Sep 2025 
• Led Agile delivery as de facto Product Owner across 65+ enterprise BFSI, Healthcare, and Retail clients; managed parallel

• Capital Markets & Wealth Management: Supported backlog and sprint delivery for Equities, ECM, Fixed Income (Govt Bonds, 
Corporate Bonds, T-Bills, Debentures, CPs, CDs), FX, and Wealth Management platforms; translated investment and advisory

• UPI & Payments (SBI): Led requirements definition for UPI/NPCI integration and merchant onboarding for a leading PSU bank; 
defined P2P and P2M transaction flows, NPCI API integration specs, and merchant registration journeys; ensured adherence to 
NPCI guidelines and RBI payment system regulations. 
• AML/KYC & Regulatory: Drove backlog grooming and sprint delivery for AML transaction monitoring, KYC onboarding, and 
RBI/SEBI/GST reporting dashboards; performed regulatory gap assessments and ensured near-zero post-UAT defects. 
• Cards & Core Banking: Delivered requirements for card issuance, payment gateway integrations, reconciliation platforms, and 
core banking workflows; designed REST API integration layers aligned to RBI guidelines. 
• Collaborated with business, technology, UX, risk, cyber, fraud, legal, and compliance stakeholders to elicit and validate 
requirements; built Power BI/SQL dashboards for sprint health and delivery risk. 
Logistics Analyst | Arvato Bertelsmann Nov 2017 – Sep 2018 
• Improved delivery KPIs and operational performance by streamlining escalation processes between logistics and warehousing 
teams.
